Tried again for ClinikEHR (the founder's #1 candidate, already confirmed real content when researching Pharmacy) — found a page element literally reading 'RSS' on their blog homepage, strong evidence a feed exists, but still could not determine the exact feed URL with the same confidence as the WordPress /feed/ pattern used elsewhere, so left out rather than guess a URL with zero direct evidence.
